# Suit Heat

> Calculate the heat index and risk level for your crew, see why chemical protective clothing makes heat stress worse, and train on PPE and site safety.

Suit Heat (https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, HAZWOPER Supervisor, 8-Hour Refresher training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Heat stress, PPE and site safety in depth. Enroll: https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). Planning work/rest and monitoring crews. Enroll: https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual refresher. Enroll: https://heat-stress.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
